context.title: San Diego Education Association: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Diego Unified School District — Measure M (San Diego Unified School District Repair, Student Safety, No Tax Rate Increase Measure)

positions.statement: Monique Barrett (President, San Diego Education Association) signed the argument in favor of San Diego Unified School District Measure M in the San Diego County Voter Information Pamphlets.
